behavior: After changing a form-field type, focus returns to the replacement type selector.
After deleting a field, focus moves to the next field at the same index, or the previous field when deleting the last field.
Adding a field allocates a unique field-N id and focuses its label control.
Inspector field edits do not implicitly save or publish, and do not mutate the page draft or published-page snapshot.
